title: eludite.agents.permission input
description: Answer a pending permission request in the Agents window, as its dialog's buttons do: Allow, Always Allow (writes an allow rule into the solution's committable policy file, .eludite/agents-policy.json) or Deny. Requests come from the agent (ACP session/request_permission) and from Eludite's MCP server for execute and dangerous commands.

request.description: The request's id as the transcript shows it. Omit to answer the oldest pending request.
